correctness.rationale: For the Pappus graph specified by LCF [5,7,-7,7,-7,-5]^3, verify the canonical unordered Abrams cubical model has 153 0-, 432 1- and 297 2-cells and signed boundary1 boundary2=0. Independent exact bitset ranks give d2 rank269 over F2 and 270 over F3. d1 rank152; ten independent fundamental graph cycles lift as closed one-particle motions with a stationary spectator, providing rational H1>=10 and hence rational d2<=270, matching the F3 lower bound. Thus rational Betti (1,10,27). Independently enumerated 216 graph automorphisms and reconstructible signed cubical Lefschetz H1/H2 characters for 13 conjugacy classes; average characters over 216 and bipartition-preserving 108 vanish in positive degrees. Pappus is not claimed to have torsion-free integral H1; only rational representation is proved.
